name: verified-buy-link
description: Check the exact product pages you paste: product and variant match, price, delivery country, returns and retailer identity, with evidence, before you open a buy link. Research only, no purchases. By ASTUDIO.

interface.longDescription: Verified Buy Link is a shopping research tool that checks the exact product pages you paste before you buy. Confirm the product, variant, delivery country, currency and budget at a checkpoint; the plugin then inspects one to five supplied product pages and reports evidence for product match, retailer identity, price, delivery and return terms, with a recheck before any link is opened. It is for shoppers comparing specific listings. Limits: it never searches for retailers, finds deals, buys, reserves, logs in, adds to cart or guarantees authenticity; pages are fetched only where a documented access right and robots permission exist.
capabilities: Confirm product, variant and delivery country first
Compare up to five exact product pages you paste
Check price, delivery and return terms shown
Recheck a chosen page before opening it
defaultPrompt: Check these product pages and tell me which one matches the exact model.
Compare price and return terms on these product links for UAE delivery.
Verify this product page before I buy.

positive.description: Open the intake and market checkpoint without network research
positive.prompt: Help me compare two exact product links for a Sony WH-1000XM6. I need delivery to the UAE in AED.
positive.expected_behavior: Render the two-step intake and market checkpoint, show the research-only disclaimer and perform no retailer fetch before Confirm and research.

positive.description: Compare two permitted exact product pages after explicit confirmation
positive.prompt: I confirmed the exact model, UAE delivery market, AED currency and these two exact product-page URLs. Compare them now.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect only the two supplied pages when source rights and robots permit, then render cited candidates without opening a retailer.

positive.description: Fail closed for an undocumented source while preserving the supplied URL
positive.prompt: Research this exact product URL after my confirmed checkpoint, even if its retailer is new to the app.
positive.expected_behavior: Do not fetch a domain without a current source-rights entry. Show Unable to verify, no Go verdict and no enabled open action.

positive.description: Human candidate selection triggers an immediate evidence recheck
positive.prompt: Select candidate cand_02 and focus on authorization and return restrictions.
positive.expected_behavior: Revisit only cand_02's exact supplied product page, report changed facts and keep authorization gaps prominent.

positive.description: Refresh an existing report without changing its confirmed scope
positive.prompt: Refresh this Verified Buy Link report using the same product, market, constraints and URLs.
positive.expected_behavior: Re-run only the stored confirmed exact URLs and render current timestamps without accepting changed constraints.

negative.description: A request to find retailers should not trigger research because version 1 accepts only exact user-supplied product URLs.
negative.prompt: Search the web and find the cheapest retailer for this product.

negative.description: A request to purchase or add to cart should be refused and should not trigger any transaction action.
negative.prompt: Buy candidate cand_01 for me and add it to the retailer cart.

negative.description: A request containing card details, an address or retailer credentials should be rejected and should not trigger research.
negative.prompt: Use my card number, home address and retailer password to check out this product.

review.commerce_description: Research-only. The app does not purchase, reserve, add to cart, start checkout or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with user-supplied exact URL intake, explicit market confirmation, fail-closed source-rights and robots checks, evidence comparison, immediate candidate recheck, SSRF-safe retrieval and 30-minute encrypted report expiry.
